entries.title: Proverbs 29:1
segments: ¶A man hating sharp words and making his heart hard, will suddenly be broken and will not be made well again.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:2
segments: ¶When the upright have power, the people are glad; when an evil man is ruler, grief comes on the people.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:3
segments: ¶A man who is a lover of wisdom is a joy to his father: but he who goes in the company of loose women is a waster of wealth.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:4
segments: ¶A king, by right rule, makes the land safe; but one full of desires makes it a waste.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:5
segments: ¶A man who says smooth things to his neighbour is stretching out a net for his steps.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:6
segments: ¶In the steps of an evil man there is a net for him, but the upright man gets away quickly and is glad.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:7
segments: ¶The upright man gives attention to the cause of the poor: the evil-doer gives no thought to it.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:8
segments: ¶Men of pride are the cause of violent acts in a town, but by wise men wrath is turned away.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:9
segments: ¶If a wise man goes to law with a foolish man, he may be angry or laughing, but there will be no rest.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:10
segments: ¶Men of blood are haters of the good man, and evil-doers go after his soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:11
segments: ¶A foolish man lets out all his wrath, but a wise man keeps it back quietly.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:12
segments: ¶If a ruler gives attention to false words, all his servants are evil-doers.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:13
segments: ¶The poor man and his creditor come face to face: the Lord gives light to their eyes equally.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:14
segments: ¶The king who is a true judge in the cause of the poor, will be safe for ever on the seat of his power.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:15
segments: ¶The rod and sharp words give wisdom: but a child who is not guided is a cause of shame to his mother.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:16
segments: ¶When evil men are in power, wrongdoing is increased; but the upright will have pleasure when they see their downfall.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:17
segments: ¶Give your son training, and he will give you rest; he will give delight to your soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:18
segments: ¶Where there is no vision, the people are uncontrolled; but he who keeps the law will be happy.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:19
segments: ¶A servant will not be trained by words; for though the sense of the words is clear to him, he will not give attention.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:20
segments: ¶Have you seen a man who is quick with his tongue? There is more hope for a foolish man than for him.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:21
segments: ¶If a servant is gently cared for from his early years, he will become a cause of sorrow in the end.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:22
segments: ¶An angry man is the cause of fighting, and a man given to wrath does much wrong.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:23
segments: ¶A man's pride will be the cause of his fall, but he who has a gentle spirit will get honour.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:24
segments: ¶A man who takes part with a thief has hate for his soul; he is put under oath, but says nothing.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:25
segments: ¶The fear of man is a cause of danger: but whoever puts his faith in the Lord will have a safe place on high.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:26
segments: ¶The approval of a ruler is desired by great numbers: but the decision in a man's cause comes from the Lord.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:27
segments: ¶An evil man is disgusting to the upright, and he who is upright is disgusting to evil-doers.
